title: Expose authenticated owner inquiry cancellation
requirements: Extend only POST /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{inquiry_id}/commands to accept the strict CANCEL envelope {type:'CANCEL',expected_version,expected_visit_versions,payload:{reason}} and delegate only to OwnerCommandService.cancel_inquiry.
Preserve CONFIRM, START_NEGOTIATION and COMPLETE behavior exactly, including authenticated owner session, exact Origin, JSON, CSRF, Idempotency-Key and no-store boundary.
Strict CANCEL shape rejects before dispatch and does not consume the idempotency key; malformed inquiry UUID is 404. Map existing OwnerCommandError categories consistently with the core contract.

Add isolated synthetic PostgreSQL route tests for successful planned and unplanned cancellation, reason validation, participation closure while preserving the visit/group, audit/receipt response, invalid state/version/visit maps with no mutation and reusable key, stable replay/mismatch/expiry, and compatibility of CONFIRM, START_NEGOTIATION and COMPLETE.
Do not add other commands, group cancellation, payments, migrations, frontend, bots, notifications or external integrations.
acceptance: A signed-in owner can cancel one inquiry through the command endpoint with the required reason and optimistic versions.
Browser, strict envelope, version and idempotency boundaries protect cancellation without partial history or unrelated visit mutation.
Focused synthetic PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted narrow HTTP adapter over reviewed cancellation core with compatibility safeguards.
